name: Holiday Classic Smooth Deviled Eggs (Paprika & Dijon — No Relish)
whyItWorks: While everyone else snacks on raw veggie trays and mixed nuts before holiday dinner, smooth deviled eggs give you zero-fiber, dairy-free protein that won't hurt your stomach.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Make with mashed egg yolks, mayo, a touch of mustard, and sweet paprika (not cayenne), and leave out chopped pickle relish or jalapenos.
watchOuts: Skip deviled eggs topped with jalapeño slices or cayenne pepper
